definitions.explanation: The act of receiving and entertaining visitors or guests, especially in a formal or business setting.

examples.japanese: {応接|おうせつ}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧。
examples.english: Please wait in the reception room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来客|らいきゃく}→来客：13061_raikyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{応接|おうせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われて→追う：02016_ou⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{応接|おうせつ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new reception room furniture set.
